object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

Your Just-In-Time (JIT) activation will expire in 15 minutes.

#if($applicationName)

Application: $applicationName

#end #if($activationUrl)

You can extend or manage your access in $__global.productName here.

#end
Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Notifies a user that their Just-In-Time activation expires in 15 minutes.
object.name: Just-In-Time Activation - 15 Minute Reminder
object.subject: Your Just-In-Time access for ${entitlementName} expires in 15 minutes
